# Effects, transitions, looks and text animations

Every visual technique is an **effect id** with an ordered chain of implementations, best first. The resolver picks the
best one this machine can run (installed effects are asked of After Effects itself); the last link of every chain needs
nothing, so a missing plugin degrades the result and is reported, but never blocks the edit. `xoxo effects` prints the
chains for *your* machine.

## transition

| Id | What it does | Fallback chain (quality) | Needs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transition.dissolve` | Cross dissolve (incoming layer fades up over the outgoing tail). | opacity_fade (1) | nothing |
| `transition.dip_to_black` | Outgoing fades to black, incoming fades up from black. | opacity_dip (1) | nothing |
| `transition.slide` | Incoming scene slides over the outgoing one. | position_slide (1) → dissolve_instead (0.3) | nothing |
| `transition.zoom_punch` | Fast push-through: outgoing scales up, incoming settles from oversized. | scale_punch (1) | nothing |
| `transition.wipe` | Outgoing scene is wiped away to reveal the incoming one. | linear_wipe (1) → slide_instead (0.5) → dissolve_instead (0.3) | Linear Wipe |
| `transition.glitch` | Digital glitch transition. | turbulent_displace (1) → jitter_flash (0.55) → hard_cut (0.1) | Turbulent Displace |
| `transition.cut` | Hard cut. | cut (1) | nothing |

## shot_transition

| Id | What it does | Fallback chain (quality) | Needs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shot.transition.cut` | Hard cut. | cut (1) | nothing |
| `shot.transition.dissolve` | Cross dissolve. | opacity_fade (1) | nothing |
| `shot.transition.whip` | Whip pan: the outgoing shot whips away, the incoming whips in; the swap is hidden in the blur. | whip_directional_blur (1) → whip_layer_motion_blur (0.75) → dissolve_instead (0.3) | Directional Blur |
| `shot.transition.zoom` | Zoom punch-through: the outgoing shot pushes in hard, the incoming settles from oversized. | zoom_radial_blur (1) → zoom_scale_only (0.8) → dissolve_instead (0.3) | CC Radial Fast Blur |
| `shot.transition.push` | Push: the incoming shot slides in and shoves the outgoing one off. | push_slide (1) → dissolve_instead (0.3) | nothing |
| `shot.transition.pull` | Pull-through: a soft, slow cousin of the zoom with no blur - the incoming shot relaxes from slightly oversized. | pull_soft (1) → dissolve_instead (0.3) | nothing |
| `shot.transition.light` | Light: a warm bloom washes over the cut. | light_ramp_glow (1) → light_warm_flash (0.6) → dissolve_instead (0.3) | Gradient Ramp |
| `shot.transition.light_leak` | Light leak: a supplied light-leak overlay clip screens over the cut (needs an overlay asset). | leak_overlay (1) → dissolve_instead (0.3) | nothing |
| `shot.transition.mask` | Mask wipe: a feathered edge sweeps across and reveals the incoming shot. | linear_wipe (1) → matte_slide (0.8) → push_instead (0.5) → dissolve_instead (0.3) | Linear Wipe |
| `shot.transition.luma` | Brightness dissolve: the incoming shot burns in from over-exposed (a luma-style dissolve, not a matte wipe). | exposure_dissolve (1) → ease_in_expo_dissolve (0.5) → dissolve_instead (0.3) | Exposure |
| `shot.transition.flash` | Flash cut: a white flash covers a hard cut. | white_flash (1) → dissolve_instead (0.3) | nothing |
| `shot.transition.glitch` | Glitch: both shots shake and tear while the swap happens under displacement. | glitch_displace (1) → glitch_jitter_flash (0.55) → hard_cut (0.1) | Turbulent Displace |
| `shot.transition.distortion` | Distortion: a wave warp ripples through the zoom. | wave_warp_zoom (1) → zoom_instead (0.5) → dissolve_instead (0.3) | Wave Warp |
| `shot.transition.motion_blur` | Swish: a fast, heavily blurred slide between shots. | swish_directional_blur (1) → swish_layer_motion_blur (0.7) → dissolve_instead (0.3) | Directional Blur |

## text_anim

| Id | What it does | Fallback chain (quality) | Needs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text.anim.fade` | Plain fade up. | fade (1) | nothing |
| `text.anim.slide` | Slides a short distance while fading in. | slide (1) → fade_instead (0.4) | nothing |
| `text.anim.blur_reveal` | Resolves out of a blur. | gaussian_blur (1) → scale_settle (0.55) → fade_instead (0.4) | Gaussian Blur |
| `text.anim.mask_reveal` | Wiped on from one side. | linear_wipe (1) → slide (0.6) → fade_instead (0.4) | Linear Wipe |
| `text.anim.tracking_reveal` | Letters spread from tight to their final spacing. | tracking_animator (1) → scale_settle (0.55) → fade_instead (0.4) | nothing |
| `text.anim.word_reveal` | Words arrive one after another. | word_animator (1) → char_animator (0.8) → fade_instead (0.4) | nothing |
| `text.anim.character_reveal` | Typewriter, letter by letter. | typewriter (1) → char_fade_up (0.7) → fade_instead (0.4) | nothing |
| `text.anim.scale_punch` | Slams in oversized and settles with a small overshoot. | overshoot_scale (1) → fade_instead (0.4) | nothing |
| `text.anim.kinetic` | Words flash in one at a time on the beat, each with a punch. | word_by_word (1) → word_animator (0.7) → fade_instead (0.4) | nothing |
| `text.anim.glitch_reveal` | Flickers and tears in, then locks. | displace_flicker (1) → jitter_flicker (0.6) → fade_instead (0.4) | Turbulent Displace |
